exposure: Neonatal state (within 24 hours of spontaneous term birth)
outcome: mRNA expression of oligodendrocyte lineage markers
mRNA expression of neuronal development markers
mRNA expression of GABAergic pathway maturation markers
mRNA expression of glutamatergic pathway maturation markers
cohort: The participants were guinea pig fetuses collected at gestational age 68 and neonates collected within 24 hours of spontaneous term birth.
finding: The study identified important adaptations in neurodevelopmental structures, including reduced mature myelin and increased neuronal nuclei coverage, alongside widespread mRNA changes in oligodendrocyte, neuronal, GABAergic, and glutamatergic pathways during the fetal-to-neonatal transition.
followup_time: Up to 24 hours after birth (for the neonatal group)
gest_age: Gestational age 68 (for fetal collection) and term delivery (for neonatal collection)
